Welcome to my first workflowr website.

I have performed an analysis using the data set ToothGrowth. It contains the length of the teeth for 60 guinea pigs given 3 different doses of vitamin C either via orange juice (OC) or directly with ascorbic acid (VC).

I want to compare the tooth length of the guinea pigs given orange juice versus those given vitamin C, so I have performed a permutation-based statistical test. This involved comparing the observed difference in teeth length due to the supplement method to the observed differences calculated from random permutations of the data.

[Analysis teeth](teeth.html)
